chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a music-box winds up: a gentle rising arpeggio, one warm chime, and a soft held chord that eases into the waltz}
positive_styles: warm G major with a gentle minor turn
rounded music-box and soft pulse-wave lead singing a lullaby melody
gentle waltz synth bass falling root to fifth
soft brushes on beats two and three, a single chime per phrase
cosy lantern-lit village hearth, safe and homely

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the lullaby melody in lilting 3/4: a hopeful rising leap that settles home rounded and even, tuneful and cosy, the bass rocking the waltz}
